HomeDock OS - The Self-hosted Cloud OS to Simplify Your Life

 
 
 

Take control of the cloud like never before. 800+ self-hosted apps, a real desktop in your browser, and every file you own a double-click away. Free, private, and running on whatever hardware you already have. 

---

 Deploy HomeDock OS everywhere. Available for all platforms. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

---

 
 
 

---

 HomeDock OS in Numbers

 
 
 
 
 
 

- 800+ apps — 180+ curated in the official App Store, plus community stores one click away.
- 80+ file types — Photos, camera RAWs, PSDs, spreadsheets, CSVs, Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, PDFs, code, music and video, right in the browser.
- Zero plugins — No office suite, no codecs, no image editor to install. It all ships inside HomeDock OS.
- 3 OSes, 4 architectures — Linux, macOS and Windows, on x86, x86 64, ARM and ARM64. Yes, even a Raspberry Pi Zero.
- 1 certificate — A single automatic Let's Encrypt wildcard covers every app you install, without opening a port for it.
- €0, forever — The full desktop, free. No trial, no account, no strings attached.

---

 Why HomeDock OS?

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 Universal Compatibility Any device is your new device. HomeDock OS runs on Linux, Windows, macOS and Raspberry Pi, on legacy and modern hardware alike. 
 
 
 
 Privacy by Design Your data, your rules. Your files stay on your machine, encrypted where it matters, both on-premise and in the cloud. 
 
 
 
 Reachable From Anywhere Any device with a browser is a way in, with HTTPS certificates HomeDock OS obtains and renews for you. 
 
 
 
 A Desktop, Not a Dashboard Powered by our Prism Window Manager , HomeDock OS feels like the operating system on your laptop, not a grid of links. 
 
 

---

 800+ Apps, One Click Away

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 Jellyfin, Immich, Nextcloud, Home Assistant, Plex, Vaultwarden, Pi-hole… and hundreds more. 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Official App Store 180+ curated applications , from Nextcloud to Jellyfin, Immich to Home Assistant, in an App Store you already know how to use: Discover, categories, a Library with what you installed, and an Updates tab. Install anything in seconds. 
 
 
 
 Seven Community Stores Casa App Store , BigBearTechWorld , ReCasa App Store , TMC Store , Zima App Store , Coolstore and Casa LinuxServer , one click each from Packager. Their apps are converted to HomeDock OS packages automatically, icons, volumes, networks and ports included, taking your catalogue past 800 applications . 
 
 
 
 Know Before You Download Every app page shows how much it will download on your server, dependencies included, and warns you when an app wasn't built for your processor before you install it. 
 
 
 
 Advanced Install Config Ports, volumes, environment variables, network mode, capabilities and privileged mode, or the raw compose file if you prefer. Port conflicts tell you exactly which app is in the way, and default credentials come with copy-to-clipboard. 
 
 
 
 Packager Build your own .hds packages from any Docker Compose file with a live preview of how they'll look in the App Store, bundle dozens of them into a .hdstore file, and migrate CasaOS compose files in one drop. Open formats: every package is a signed ZIP you can always unzip. 
 
 
 
 Automatic Updates Apps on :latest are checked in the background, with a badge in the taskbar and an Update All button when there's more than one. 
 
 

 Community stores are run by their own maintainers and subject to availability. If one goes offline, it temporarily disappears from Packager until it's back. 

---

 Opens Your Files, No Plugins Required

Double-click a file in the File Explorer and it opens right there, in your browser, with nothing extra to install. Photos show real thumbnails, and you can drop files from your computer straight onto any viewer.

 
 
 

 Formats 
 :-----------------: ------- 
 Images 
 Camera RAW 
 Spreadsheets opened and edited in Sheets , with formulas and formatting kept intact · edited as a sheet and saved back with their own separator 
 Documents opened and edited in Writer · in the PDF Editor : search, fill in forms, annotate , sign and reorder pages · with live preview in Notepad 
 Presentations opened in Slides , with slide thumbnails and a full-screen presenter mode 
 Code and more, 45 extensions with syntax highlighting 
 Archives browsed, previewed and extracted in Zipfile , password-protected ZIPs included · compress anything to ZIP, with or without a password 
 Video 
 Audio with cover art and a 3D/2D live spectrum analyzer 

Every file is checked against its magic bytes before it opens, so a renamed executable never gets treated as a picture.

---

 A Real Desktop in Your Browser

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Prism Window Manager Resizable, draggable, snappable windows with real multitasking: watch logs while an app installs and files upload. Quick View ( F3 ) spreads every open window out at once. 
 
 
 
 OnScreen Apps Your self-hosted apps open inside HomeDock OS as real windows, not as a pile of browser tabs. Put Jellyfin next to Immich next to a terminal and use them all at once. 
 
 
 
 Start Menu & Finder Start typing and your apps and files show up. Pin what you use, find what you opened last, and search everything Spotlight-style. 
 
 
 
 Widgets Clock, System, Storage, Notes, Network, Calendar, Media and Shortcut, right on the desktop. 
 
 
 
 Your Desktop Follows You Folders, icons, widgets and pins are stored on the server, so every device sees the same desktop, rearranged to fit its screen. 
 
 
 
 Built for Phones Too Swipeable home screen pages, full-screen windows, long-press menus and an App Store with a tab bar, like the phone in your pocket. 
 
 
 
 Three Themes Default (light), Noir (dark) and Aero+ (glass), themed down to the last context menu. Bring your own wallpaper. 
 
 

---

 Your Apps, Under Control
